# Editor's review pack

For Dr Kunda Shahane, editor-in-chief. Everything that needs her decision or signature is in this one document.
Each claim appears once, even if several units use it. Claims she has already verified are not repeated.

**7 unit(s) awaiting signature. 46 claim(s) to check. 3 decision(s).**

## Part A. Decisions

**Q1. ASE guideline: are the aortic arch and isthmus required or optional sites for pulsed-wave Doppler in a fetal echocardiogram? The text (p. 689) and Table 6 (p. 693) appear to differ.**

- [ ] Teach as optional (as in Table 6)
- [ ] Teach as required (as in the text)
- [ ] State both and explain

If no answer: Wait for the ChatGPT cross-check of claim AS23-014 against the PDF; if the difference is real, teach as optional and note the text.
Affects: Unit F1

**Q2. After a normal early (11 to 14 week) heart check, may the course say plainly that the full second-trimester cardiac screen is still required?**

- [ ] Yes, say it plainly as the editor's teaching
- [ ] Only once a source is added

If no answer: Left out of unit D9 until a source is added.
Affects: Unit D9

**Q3. Does the consent held for archive cases cover publication for teaching in a paid product (not only clinical care)?**

- [ ] Yes, wording covers it
- [ ] No or unsure: re-consent or do not use
- [ ] Ask the legal advisor

If no answer: No archive clip is published until this is confirmed in writing.
Affects: All clip drills and the case atlas
